metrics.name: Model-role utility profile
metrics.evaluation_unit: terminal task with complete canonical provider/model/Role/Runtime attribution per contributing call

value_semantics.missing: N/A when a measure lacks its required sample or coverage

metrics.time_window: declared as-of cutoff and event-time cohort
metrics.calculation: Publish outcome, adjusted failure, retry, repair, reopen, latency, token, cost, intervention and reviewer-finding validity separately; Pareto only among evidence-ready peers.
uncertainty: each measure retains its own sample, coverage and unit
forbidden_inference: do not collapse measures into one score
do not infer causality

metrics.name: Role-template rework rate
metrics.evaluation_unit: eligible terminal task in one event-time role-template cohort

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible terminal tasks exist

metrics.time_window: declared as-of cutoff and event-time role-template cohort
metrics.calculation: Terminal tasks with at least one linked attributable repair divided by eligible terminal tasks; publish numerator and denominator.
uncertainty: repair association is descriptive and not causal
forbidden_inference: do not infer template causality
do not backfill assignments

metrics.name: Role-template trajectory partial cost
metrics.evaluation_unit: eligible terminal task trajectory in one event-time role-template cohort

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no attributable same-currency cost exists

metrics.time_window: declared as-of cutoff and event-time role-template cohort
metrics.calculation: Sum linked provider/host-reported cost for covered task trajectories separately by exact currency, source and cost basis; publish coverage.
eligibility: direct cost has exact source, currency and cost basis
exclusions: mixed currency, source or cost basis
uncertainty: reported value is partial attributable cost
forbidden_inference: do not label as total cost
do not convert currency implicitly

metrics.name: Role-model task outcome rate
metrics.evaluation_unit: eligible terminal task with complete canonical model-role attribution

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible attributed terminal tasks exist

metrics.time_window: declared as-of cutoff and comparable cohort
metrics.calculation: Tasks in each unique task-outcome category divided by eligible attributed terminal tasks; publish numerator and denominator per category.
forbidden_inference: do not infer model causality
do not compare incompatible cohorts

metrics.name: Packet rework rate

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible packets exist

metrics.calculation: Packets with at least one linked attributable repair divided by eligible packets; publish numerator and denominator.
uncertainty: repair occurrence does not state defect severity
forbidden_inference: do not infer causal fault

metrics.name: Operational latency
metrics.evaluation_unit: operational model call with native host-reported Span duration

value_semantics.missing: N/A when native model-call Span duration is unavailable

metrics.calculation: Sum eligible call durations divided by contributing calls; also publish contributing-call count.
uncertainty: host-reported latency is operational and not Delivery elapsed time
forbidden_inference: do not substitute C55 or zero
do not infer causality

metrics.name: Trajectory partial cost
metrics.evaluation_unit: Delivery trajectory with linked host/provider-reported cost

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no attributable same-currency trajectory cost exists

metrics.calculation: Sum linked costs separately by exact source, unit or currency and cost basis over covered trajectories; publish coverage.
exclusions: mixed currency, source or cost basis
uncertainty: reported value is partial attributable cost
forbidden_inference: do not label as total cost
do not convert currency implicitly

metrics.name: Task cohort comparison eligibility
metrics.evaluation_unit: task in the declared defined-task snapshot

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no defined tasks exist

metrics.calculation: Comparable eligible terminal tasks divided by all defined tasks; publish every exclusion reason separately.
eligibility: task passes Metric Catalog §6.2 rules 2 through 5
uncertainty: eligibility measures evidence readiness, not outcome quality
forbidden_inference: do not drop excluded tasks from the denominator
do not reconstruct missing membership

metrics.name: Delivery stage reach

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no linked terminal Deliveries exist

metrics.calculation: Deliveries with direct C56 reached-stage fact divided by linked terminal Deliveries; publish exact stage identities separately.
exclusions: absent or invalid C56 from the reached-stage numerator
uncertainty: stage identity does not imply unobserved stage traversal
forbidden_inference: do not infer stage from workflow order or text

metrics.name: Delivery terminal outcome rate

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no explicitly terminated Deliveries exist

metrics.calculation: Deliveries in each recorded terminal outcome divided by explicitly terminated Deliveries; publish numerator and denominator per outcome.
eligibility: exact terminal Delivery identity and outcome
uncertainty: Delivery outcome is not task outcome
forbidden_inference: do not infer a task-level outcome

metrics.name: Delivery cycle time
metrics.evaluation_unit: explicitly terminated Delivery with direct C55 elapsed time

value_semantics.missing: N/A when direct C55 elapsed time is unavailable

metrics.calculation: Sum eligible C55 milliseconds divided by contributing terminal Deliveries; also publish contributing-Delivery count.
eligibility: terminal Delivery with finite nonnegative C55
uncertainty: C55 is owner-reported Delivery elapsed time
forbidden_inference: do not derive from arrival time
do not substitute model-call latency or zero

metrics.name: Operational token usage
metrics.evaluation_unit: operational model call with reported standard token usage

value_semantics.missing: N/A when compatible reported token measurements are unavailable

filters: reported standard input or output token measurement
metrics.calculation: Sum reported input and output token measures separately within identical cohorts; publish coverage and do not synthesize total tokens.
eligibility: reported compatible input or output token measurement
uncertainty: reported values are partial attributable usage
forbidden_inference: do not synthesize missing total tokens
do not label as total usage

metrics.name: Operational attributable cost
metrics.evaluation_unit: operational call with linked provider or host-reported project-attributable cost

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no project-attributable same-currency cost exists

metrics.calculation: Sum only exact same-source, same-unit or currency and same-cost-basis values; publish coverage.
eligibility: direct linked project-attributable cost with exact basis
exclusions: mixed source, unit, currency or basis
uncertainty: reported value is partial attributable cost
forbidden_inference: do not estimate or convert
do not label as total cost

metrics.name: Operational usage availability

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible operational model calls exist

metrics.calculation: Calls with explicit applicable usage source divided by eligible model calls; publish numerator and denominator.
exclusions: unsupported call identity or compatibility context
uncertainty: availability does not state the amount of usage
forbidden_inference: do not turn missing usage into zero usage

metrics.name: Direct evidence basis rate

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible facts exist

metrics.calculation: Facts with direct accepted host or provider basis divided by eligible facts; publish numerator and denominator.
eligibility: eligible fact identity with accepted provenance context
forbidden_inference: do not infer semantic correctness from provenance
